decision_policy.A: Only customer multiplicity meets the clear material improvement rule.
decision_policy.B: Only aggregation choice meets the substantial aggregation rule.
decision_policy.C: Only C_LOGIT minus W_LOGIT meets the clear material improvement rule.
decision_policy.D: None of A/B/C is supported and C_LOGIT fails to improve both observed primary metrics; the historical direct-customer advantage appears primarily representational.
decision_policy.E: More than one mechanism is supported, or the remaining pattern is mixed/inconclusive.

strongest_defensible_paper_claim: The pre-specified controls did not isolate a clear multiplicity, aggregation, or customer-loss mechanism; the formulation explanation remains inconclusive.
research_matrix_recommendation: Freeze the AMP development experiment matrix.
genuinely_unresolved_validity_issue: No serious unresolved internal-validity issue requiring another development experiment was identified; temporal label noise remains inherently unidentifiable without new timing ground truth.
